purpose: Classify any knowledge bit into the StudySyndicate factored domain and emit reusable study sets. Private workspace findings graduate forward; reusable lessons never flow backward.

input.bit: free text, code, source-note, media reference, or problem statement

emit_study_sets.weak_area_tag: concept linked to attempts for the weakness map
emit_study_sets.schedule: FSRS schedule component for spaced repetition

evidence_rule: Assistance is provenance, never mastery. Graduation requires blank-file reconstruction and executable proof per the target StudySyndicate gates.
